critical_path_summary.staffing_implication: Full-Stack Developer and QA Analyst must be dedicated (not shared) across Phases 2-4; PM carries critical path through all phases and cannot context-switch.

phases.name: Discovery & Design
milestones: Stakeholder alignment session completed with CFO/IT/Finance sign-off
User personas and success metrics finalized
API and database schema approved by Backend Developer

tasks.name: Conduct stakeholder alignment session and confirm scope with CFO/IT Manager
tasks.definition_of_done: Written sign-off from CFO and IT Manager confirming scope, timeline, and trade-off authority.

tasks.name: Define user personas, success metrics, and adoption plan
tasks.definition_of_done: Document with 3 personas (Employee, Manager, Finance), 4 success metrics, and post-launch ownership plan.

tasks.name: Design API endpoints and database schema for expense claims
tasks.definition_of_done: OpenAPI spec with all 7 endpoints (auth, submit, list, approve, reject, export) and PostgreSQL schema diagram approved by PM.

tasks.name: Create UI wireframes for employee and manager workflows
tasks.definition_of_done: Figma wireframes for submit form, approval queue, and export screen reviewed by stakeholders.

tasks.name: Set up development environment, CI/CD pipeline, and Azure infrastructure
tasks.definition_of_done: GitHub repo, Azure App Service, PostgreSQL instance, and GitHub Actions pipeline ready for code commits.

phases.name: Core Development
milestones: Azure AD SSO authentication working end-to-end
Employee submit and manager approval workflows functional

tasks.name: Implement Azure AD SSO login and session management
tasks.definition_of_done: Users can log in via Azure AD, session persists across page reloads, logout clears session.

tasks.name: Build employee expense submission form with receipt upload
tasks.definition_of_done: Form accepts amount, category, date, description; uploads receipt to Azure Blob Storage; saves to PostgreSQL.

tasks.name: Implement manager approval queue and approval/rejection logic
tasks.definition_of_done: Manager sees pending claims, can approve/reject with one click, status updates in database.

tasks.name: Build employee expense history view (last 6 months)
tasks.definition_of_done: Employee can filter by status (submitted, approved, rejected) and date range.

tasks.name: Integrate SendGrid for approval/rejection email notifications
tasks.definition_of_done: Employees receive email when claim is approved or rejected; email includes claim details and manager comment.

tasks.name: Conduct internal demo with stakeholders and capture feedback
tasks.definition_of_done: Demo covers submit, approve, reject, and history workflows; feedback documented and prioritized.

phases.name: Integration & Edge Cases
milestones: CSV export functionality tested with Finance team
All integrations (Azure AD, SendGrid, Blob Storage) validated
Security review completed by IT Security

tasks.name: Build Finance CSV export endpoint with monthly filtering
tasks.definition_of_done: Finance staff can export all approved expenses for a given month as CSV; file includes employee name, amount, category, date.

tasks.name: Implement data validation and error handling for all user inputs
tasks.definition_of_done: All form fields validated client-side and server-side; error messages clear and actionable.

tasks.name: Conduct security review with IT Security team
tasks.definition_of_done: IT Security sign-off confirming Azure AD SSO, Blob Storage encryption, and data retention compliance.

tasks.name: Test concurrent user access and data integrity under load
tasks.definition_of_done: Simulate 60 concurrent users; verify no data loss, no duplicate submissions, no race conditions.

tasks.name: Verify Azure AD SSO, SendGrid, and Blob Storage integrations end-to-end
tasks.definition_of_done: Login via Azure AD, submit with receipt upload, receive approval email, export CSV all work without errors.

phases.name: QA & Testing
milestones: UAT completed with representative end users

tasks.name: Execute comprehensive test plan covering all 7 use cases
tasks.definition_of_done: Test matrix completed for UC1-UC7; all critical and high-priority bugs logged and triaged.

tasks.name: Conduct UAT with representative end users (1 employee, 1 manager, 1 Finance staff)
tasks.definition_of_done: UAT sign-off from all three user types; feedback incorporated or documented as post-launch.

tasks.name: Perform accessibility audit (WCAG 2.1 AA) and remediate issues
tasks.definition_of_done: Automated and manual accessibility checks pass; keyboard navigation, screen reader support, color contrast verified.

tasks.name: Write user documentation, admin runbook, and troubleshooting guide
tasks.definition_of_done: Three documents: employee quick-start guide, manager approval workflow, Finance export procedure; all reviewed by stakeholders.

tasks.name: Resolve all critical and high-priority bugs identified in testing
tasks.definition_of_done: All P0 and P1 bugs closed; P2 bugs documented for post-launch; regression testing passed.

phases.name: Deployment & Handoff
milestones: Go-live sign-off from CFO and IT Manager

tasks.name: Deploy to production and execute smoke tests
tasks.definition_of_done: Application live on Azure App Service; login, submit, approve, export all functional in production; no errors in logs.

tasks.name: Obtain go-live sign-off from CFO and IT Manager
tasks.definition_of_done: Written sign-off from CFO and IT Manager confirming readiness for employee access.

tasks.name: Confirm post-launch ownership and support escalation path
tasks.definition_of_done: Named owner (IT or Finance) confirmed; support email and escalation procedure documented and communicated to all users.
